extracted.name: Spiced clementine mulled whisky
extracted.description: Make the most of clementines at Christmas and make this warming mulled whisky. It's perfect for winter nights when you come in from the cold
ingredient_lines: 150ml clementine juice plus clementine slices to garnish
instruction_lines: Tip the ginger beer, clementine juice, honey, cinnamon sticks, cloves and allspice into a saucepan, and bring to a simmer over a low heat. Cook for 5 mins to warm through.
Remove from the heat and stir in the whisky. Divide between four heatproof glasses or mugs, drop in a few clementine slices and serve.
